notes: Identity check: multiple 'Los Reyes' branches exist (Golden Hill/2496 Broadway, Chollas View/4696 Market, Mount Hope/4239...). A Postmates listing found first resolves to the WRONG branch (2496 Broadway, confirmed via that page's own JSON-LD streetAddress) and was discarded. This Uber Eats store's address field reads '4696 Market St, San Diego, CA 92102' - exact match to the batch record, and the URL slug itself names the street. 81 items, 11 sections (Tortas, Sandwiches, Juices, Smoothies, Featured Item, The Beverages, Side Order, A La Carte, The American Breakfast, The Seafood, Extras), extracted via labelPrimary/headingPrimary accessibilityText pairs (81 labelPrimary occurrences in the raw feed = 81 items extracted, nothing missed). Cent endings are conventional (.99/.49/.25/.19/.59/.79) with no markup divisor pattern. Dish names are copied verbatim from the source feed, including the restaurant's own numbering prefixes on Juices/Smoothies ('10. Orange, Banana...', '6 Cantaloupe') and numerous apparent data-entry typos in its own listing (Straberries, Pineaplee, Testada for Tostada, Camarenes for Camarones, Deed Coffee, Butter Sodas, French Tease, Het-Cakes, Qrilled Cheese, Veggle Omelet, Biance, Mares for Siete Mares) - not transcription errors on our part, filed as-is per the rule against 'correcting' source content.

name: The Confessional by The Lost Abbey
blocked: No priced menu source found - and possibly no fixed venue menu at all. Own site (lostabbey.com/confessional, Squarespace) is a craft-beer taproom page with zero food/menu content or prices; no Toast/Square/Olo ordering link. No DoorDash/UberEats/Grubhub listing exists for this address. Third-party sources describe it as a beer-only tasting room: cardiffbythesearestaurants.com calls it 'outside-food-welcome' (implying no kitchen of its own), and cardiffvacations.com mentions 'an in-house Green Flash Gastro food truck' - i.e. food, when available, comes from a rotating food truck rather than a fixed itemized menu. Given the uncertainty over whether there is a stable food offering at all, blocked rather than not_found per the brief's rule against retiring on medium/low confidence - would need a food-truck-specific priced source or an on-site confirmation of no food service.
